mapper.select: select T1.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, T1.REMARK remark, T1.VDATE vdate, T1.MDATE mdate, T1.CCY ccy, T1.PS ps, T1.PRICE price, T1.ENTRUST_AMT entrustAmt, T2.ASSET_TYPE1 finprodType2, T2.VDATE dateStart, T2.MDATE dateEnd, T2.TERM_DAYS termDays, T3.FINPROD_ID finprodId, T5.Type_9 assetType1, T5.Type_10 assetType10, T5.Type_11 assetType11, T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, T3.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, T1.INV_MANAGER_ID invManagerId, T4.TRADER trader, T1.COUNTER_ID counterId, T1.COUNTER_TRADER counterTrader, T1.CONTACT_INFO contactInfo, T1.CHL_ID chlId, T2.IS_AGREEMENT_END isAgreementEnd from WFL_ETR_ENTRUST T1 LEFT JOIN WFL_ETR_ENTRUST_ADD T2 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T2.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_DISTRIBUTE T4 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T4.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T5 ON T3.FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID WHERE T1.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId} union all select T1.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, T1.REMARK remark, T1.VDATE vdate, T1.MDATE mdate, T1.CCY ccy, T1.PS ps, T1.PRICE price, T1.ENTRUST_AMT entrustAmt, T2.ASSET_TYPE1 finprodType2, T2.VDATE dateStart, T2.MDATE dateEnd, T2.TERM_DAYS termDays, T3.FINPROD_ID finprodId, T5.Type_9 assetType1, T5.Type_10 assetType10, T5.Type_11 assetType11, T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, T3.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, T1.INV_MANAGER_ID invManagerId, T4.TRADER trader, T1.COUNTER_ID counterId, T1.COUNTER_TRADER counterTrader, T1.CONTACT_INFO contactInfo, T1.CHL_ID chlId, T2.IS_AGREEMENT_END isAgreementEnd from ETR_ENTRUST T1 LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_ADD T2 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T2.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_DISTRIBUTE T4 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T4.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T5 ON T3.FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID WHERE T1.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}

select fp.finprod_id id,fp.finprod_name text from FIN_PRODUCT fp where fp.is_chl = 'Y' and fp.finprod_type2='F28'
AND ( FINPROD_MARKET_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) OR FINPROD_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) )
select ISSUE_AMT from FIN_PRODUCT where FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
